result: 0 of 423 with a 2xx/3xx capture in their year; any capture 1.42% (yours 2.67%)
finding: Repeating your ISC experiment reproduces your any-capture rate within error (p = 0.13), yet none of 423 records has a 2xx or 3xx capture of its host in its survey year: discovery-only evidence rarely becomes direct.
limits: 423 of 1,200 records finished by the stop time, CDX averaging 14.0 s an answer with 43 transient errors; a finished prefix is uniform. No CDX row does not prove no website, and L4 checks status, not content.
